correctness.rationale: Independent exact replay /workspace/replay/1.py used the symmetric difference of pairs of token states and disjointness of underlying labels to build all 45 vertices and 120 edges. All-pairs distances confirmed connectedness and counts 120,390,390,90. Inverting L+J (J the 45-by-45 all-ones matrix), with the inverse product checked, gives the exact voltage solution on zero-sum unit current vectors e_i-e_j, since J kills that subspace. The resulting 990 quadratic forms split into 17 buckets. Starting each bucket at its least pair and applying adjacent label transpositions gives exactly that bucket; each is therefore one S5 orbit. Every graph automorphism preserves resistance and the S5 action is by automorphisms, so the buckets also coincide with the full group orbits without needing the full group classification. All representatives, multiplicities, scaled numerators and distances match the frozen table; the exact Kirchhoff sum, characteristic polynomial, extrema and the graph-distance inversion agree.
